rules.statement: A will can be used to prove a fideicommissum even if the probate has not been registered, provided that certain conditions are met.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the reasons stated above I am of opinion that section 2 of the Registration of Old Deeds and Instruments Ordinance 1947 does not prevent a will from being used to prove a trust or fideicommissum in a case where the probate has not itself been registered as provided in that section."
